digest.component_or_area: store sync and push union guards
propositions: A stale clone with a mismatched store epoch reaching the union path must abort the merge instead of silently re-unioning stripped history, preventing data corruption during reclaim
The epoch guard must check both sync._union_merge and push.py non-fast-forward retry sites because push.py bypasses sync.py through independent git merge retries

The epoch state matrix with four rows (both absent, record-present-epoch-absent, equal epochs, mismatched epochs) plus corrupt/unreadable cases must be enforced; any non-string epoch value is treated as corrupt and aborts

At the sync site the guard returns without merging leaving the clone un-converged; at the push site it returns immediately from push_tickets_branch without entering the retry loop, preserving both refs exactly
The epoch value is stored in the existing .store-compat.json as an ISO-8601 UTC string with random suffix; older binaries ignore unknown keys so backward compatibility is maintained
After a guard-aborted non-fast-forward push, fsck must report DIVERGED (not PUSH_PENDING) with both local and remote tips byte-for-byte unchanged
